1  PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION  AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION AND ETC.
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:45593  MFA No. 7787 of 2018  THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,

WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE N S SANJAY GOWDA
The claimant is in appeal challenging the exoneration of liability of the insurer and also seeking enhancement.
2. The occurrence of the accident and liability of the insurer is not dispute.
3. The Tribunal has exonerated the insurer only on the ground that the owner of the vehicle did not produce the permit of the bus, which allowed it to ply in the route in which the accident occurred.
4. If this finding is correct, it would basically tantamount to the Insurance Company taking the plea that there is a violation of the policy conditions.
In such cases, it is settled law that the insurer would have to first pay the compensation and then recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
Thus, the finding of the Tribunal that the insurer is not liable cannot be sustained and the NC: 2024:KHC:45593 same set is aside.

It is hereby held that the insurer shall pay the compensation and then proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle after it establishes that the vehicle did not have the requisite permit.
5. As far as compensation is concerned, it is noticed that the Tribunal has taken all the factors into consideration and has rightly awarded a sum of Rs.4,89,300/-.
6. In my view, there is no justification for enhancing the compensation.

This appeal is therefore partly allowed, only to the extent of holding that the insurer would be liable to pay the compensation and thereafter, pursue recovery of the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

Sd/-
(N S SANJAY GOWDA) JUDGE Sri Ravikumar vs Sri Chandrashekar V Bhat on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88401491/
